content.title: The Independent Tiny House Could Write the Gospel of Tiny Living
content.text: Tiny living naysayers have many preconceived notions of what this alternative housing phenomenon actually entails and what a tiny house is or should be. The truth is that it takes just one excellent tiny house to turn someone into a believer, and this is the ultimate power of this beautiful French tiny house that embodies some of the best qualities of tiny living. Even its name, “the Independent”, is a perfect representation of its life-changing potential. Imagine the perfect tiny house design and you might come up with something very similar to the Independent. This French tiny house oozes universal appeal, for sure, and what makes it extra special is the intersection between traditional French artisanship and purely contemporary indoor/outdoor design. Although the dream tiny house concept is very personal, the Independent has the most chances to win everyone’s heart without even trying. It all starts with a single-level layout, which every tiny house builder in the world knows is a crown favorite. From customer who are timidly embarking on their tiny living for the first time to folks in the golden years who want to downsize comfortably and safely, a single-level layout is the best option. Couple this with a generous size (far from the standards of French homes on wheels in general) and a contemporary, fresh, indoor/outdoor flow, and you have a mansion-like abode at a smaller scale, with all the specific advantages of a mobile habitat. The Independent has more than eight meters in length (26 feet) and a standard width, which results in 18 square meters (nearly 200 square feet) of floor space, all beautifully divided into large, luminous living spaces. Photo: Ideal Tiny/Instagram Two separate entrances, both fully glazed and wide, hint at its intentional indoor/outdoor flow. While this design concept instantly brings to mind Aussie and Kiwi tiny homes, it’s highly unusual for European, and particularly French tiny homes, which typically stick to traditional patterns and rules. One of the entrances connects the bedroom (which is this tiny home’s only enclosed room) directly with the exterior deck and the natural surroundings, turning it into a self-contained, fully private oasis. Plus, that specific section of the deck, outside the bedroom, was enriched with a custom roof and support pillars that turn it into a tiny pergola-style terrace. It adds even more charm to this indoor/outdoor bedroom area. Imagine stepping outside your room straight unto this lovely terrace that provides protection against the elements and generous space for a full al-fresco or sun lounge setup. The idea is that you don’t need a fancy mansion and hefty bank loans for that – the Independent has it all for a fraction of the cost and without all the hassle. The room itself is beautifully furnished with a queen-sized bed and ingenious built-in storage: slim wardrobes on each side of the bed, and open-shelf cabinets in-between. Fully glazed doors lead to the outside deck, while a discrete, fully opaque pocket door separates the bedroom from the bathroom. Photo: Ideal Tiny/Instagram This brings us to another luxurious tiny house design feature, which is the en-suite bathroom. It’s the most convenient and easily-accessible option, and it makes a single-level layout even more luxurious. In this particular case, it’s also spacious enough to provide a welcomed separation between the toilet and the sink area, while also including an elegant shower cabin. Inside the Independent, the bathroom acts as a transition area, separating the privacy of the bedroom from the social, open vibes of the home’s kitchen and lounge. Just like the bedroom, it has two entrances. The sliding door connects it to the bedroom, while a classic door leads into the kitchen area. Some tiny houses pour their best into one specific room or part of the house while neglecting the others. This is where the Independent takes the lead and shows the best side of tiny living. Its spacious and thoughtful design doesn’t leave anything behind. If its bedroom is a lovely indoor/outdoor oasis, and its bathroom has the elegance of a hotel en-suite, the superb lounge/dining area and the open kitchen are just as impressive. The beautiful lounge is also envisioned as an indoor/outdoor space where the exterior deck becomes a literal extension of the indoor lounge, with sliding glass doors allowing owners to adjust the level of interconnection. An oversized picture window and a custom-crafted three-seat bench are part of the French builder’s signature style, but what truly takes this open living room to the next level is the four-seat dining setup with a classic table. Photo: Ideal Tiny/Instagram A tiny house with a dedicated dining area is already close to perfection, and if it can intertwine comfortable lounge seating with it, all the better. At the same time, future owners have the wonderful option to dine in the open air, thanks to the generously-sized exterior deck. Additionally, the custom lounge bench can double as a spare single bed for guests, further elevating this room’s versatility. Storage can also be a sensitive topic when it comes to tiny house design, and the Independent tiny house takes care of it perfectly. Dedicated storage is elegantly incorporated into each room, from the bedroom to the lounge, where long floating shelves mounted on the side wall prove to be the most space-efficient option. The kitchen also has multiple lower cabinets, but it skips upper cupboards to make room for a bigger window. A small fridge, a large sink, a two-burner induction stove, and a microwave are the main kitchen appliances inside the Independent, which is more than enough considering that this is primarily a two-person tiny home. Large windows and ample glazing throughout keep the entire layout bathed in natural light and visually bigger than its actual size. Sitting on a galvanized, two-axle trailer, the Independent tiny house is fully mobile and easily relocatable. High-quality materials ensure proper insulation year-round with a focus on energy efficiency. The Independent provides mansion-like comfort without the mansion costs, which can pretty much sum up the tiny living philosophy, along with the stunning connection to nature that makes every day feel like being on vacation. Photo: Ideal Tiny/Instagram The gorgeous Independent is one of the flagship designs of Ideal Tiny, a Nantes-based builder that has successfully delivered more than 200 mobile homes in the five years it has been operating. Tiny living keep expanding and growing in popularity all over the world, and homes on wheels like the French Independent play a big part in that, because they prove that this lifestyle isn’t about restrictions and compromise, but quite the opposite. It's also much easier to customize a tiny house like the Independent and make it truly your own without exorbitant costs and without wasting too much time. In other words, tiny homes like this bring the notion of dream homes to our fingertips and turn into reality. Liked the article?
